## Easily generate short links, use a branded short domain, and track performance for landing pages, multivariate tests, and files.

Salesforce brings companies & customers together in the #1 CRM platform. Get to know your customers through unified profiles. Personalize offers across any channel with AI. Build lasting relationships that drive business growth.

## Bitly and Salesforce

Integrate Bitly into your Salesforce products to achieve things like:

- Sending individualized short links to regional customers via SMS messages
- Shorten URLs directly in Salesforce products like Marketing Cloud Engagement

## Use Cases

Connect Bitly to Salesforce Social Studio

Social Studio is a content management suite for you to manage, schedule, create, and monitor posts. Organize your social posts by brand, region, or multiple teams and access real-time publishing and engagement.

Read more

Connect Bitly to Salesforce Account Engagement

With Account Engagement, your marketing team can get a better handle on generating and nurturing leads. This means better leads for the sales team, who can see when a lead engages at any point through the customer journey and reach out at the right time.

Read more

\[Use Case\] Create Personalized Short Links at Scale

Generate Short Links for use in your landing pages, multivariate tests or files and track link performance in Bitly

Read more

Use Bitly Short Links to individualize and shorten URLs for use in SMS campaigns you manage through Salesforce.
